State-Approved EMT-Basic Course

PRACTICAL SKILLS ASSESSMENT RECORD 
EMT TRAINING PROGRAM
Note any critical steps not completed to standard. Candidate must remediate all failed steps before certification is issued.
CPR — Rate, Depth, Hand Placement, Recoil
AED — Power On, Pad Placement, Clear, Shock
Vital Signs — Pulse, BP, Respirations, SpO₂
States chief complaint, age, sex, priority level
All three assessed in order, findings verbalized
Head-tilt chin-lift or jaw thrust — correct for condition
Correct device selected; appropriate flow rate applied
100–120/min, ≥2 in depth, correct position, full recoil
Systematic; no steps skipped; life threats identified
All four steps completed without interruption to CPR
Direct pressure applied; tourniquet used correctly if indicated
All four vitals accurately obtained and reported
All six components: Sx, Allergies, Meds, PMH, LO, Events
Communicates calmly; explains each procedure clearly
Instructions clear, appropriate; bystander responds correctly
Correct priority determined and justified verbally
Organized, accurate report delivered to receiving team
